newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Centrepoint expects S$17 mln rent from project.
newsitem.headline: Centrepoint expects S$17 mln rent from project.

text.p: Centrepoint Properties Ltd, part of the Fraser & Neave group, expects annual rental income of about Singapore $17 million from its shopping and serviced apartment project along the Singapore River, chief executive officer Jeffrey Heng said on Thursday.

Speaking at a media briefing at the launch of the Robertson Quay project, Heng said the S$170 million development would try to carve a niche in the overcrowded Singapore retail market by having a "Mediterranean theme" for its shopping podium.
"We have not confirmed any tenants for the project yet but we feel there is always a market for a niche product," Heng said.
The project, with 163 serviced apartments, 28 shops and 12 restaurants, is expected to open in the first half of 1998.

Heng also confirmed the company was holding talks with government-owned Pidemco Land on how to enhance their respective shopping complexes, Centrepoint and Orchard Point, located in the heart of Singapore's Orchard Road shopping district.
He said the two companies were looking into how they can compete with the highly successful Ngee Ann City Shopping Complex further up the same road.
